name: qpp_score_sufficiency
status: EXPLORATORY (all test sets already inspected; FiQA test already analysed once). Frozen and committed before any quantity below is computed. All settings and all quantities are reported regardless of outcome.
question: Does the learned failure gate's score S contain enough information about intervention gain to route well if the decision rule targets E[Delta - kappa | S] instead of ranking by predicted failure? Separates the decision rule (how S is used) from the information in S.
settings: The 13 settings of Table 2: the 11 of scripts/65 (TripClick, NQ, dense, ArguAna) and FiQA reranking and PRF (results/fiqa/runner/test_predictions.csv). S = the failure score used in Table 2. Test queries only; no new retrieval run, no refit of S.
why_not_validation: The failure detectors were fit on validation, so validation scores are in-sample and their distribution differs from test; LLM QE and dense settings also lack a matching validation Delta. Calibration is therefore cross-fitted on test folds (out-of-fold), uniformly for every setting.

policies.A_failure_ranking: Intervene on the top floor(b*n) queries by S (the paper's failure routing); always spends the budget; pays kappa per intervention.
policies.B_calibrated: Primary. 5-fold cross-fitting: in the training folds, cut S into K=10 equal-frequency bins and estimate g(bin) = mean Delta; assign each held-out query g of its bin (bin edges from training folds). Over all queries, intervene in descending g on queries with g > kappa, up to b*n; ties filled fractionally (expected value). Gain averaged over 20 random fold splits (seed 42).
policies.B_star_bin_oracle: Optimistic, in-sample reference: K=10 equal-frequency bins of S on the test queries themselves, g = in-bin mean Delta, same selection rule. The best policy measurable on those 10 bins; not a bound on all policies of S. Sensitivity: K in {5, 20}.
policies.oracle: V*(b, kappa) of scripts/65 (top floor(b*n) of (Delta-kappa)_+).

primary_contrast: Per setting, B minus A gain averaged over budgets 10/25/50/75% at kappa=0; paired bootstrap over test queries (10,000 resamples, seed 42; each resample redoes one random cross-fit), 95% CI and two-sided p; Holm over the 13 settings. Per-budget and kappa=0.02 values descriptive.
descriptive: shares of V* for A, B, B_star, random at every budget and kappa
binned profile for a candidate figure: 10 equal-frequency test bins of S with P(F), P(Delta>0), mean Delta and bootstrap 95% CI per bin
Spearman correlation of S with Delta among failing and among healthy queries

interpretation_fixed_now.decision_rule_misuses_S: B - A budget-averaged Holm-significant and positive in at least 3 of 13 settings.
interpretation_fixed_now.S_lacks_actionable_information: B_star (optimistic) realises under half of V* at the 25% budget in most settings and B is not significantly above random.
interpretation_fixed_now.intervention_dependent: Neither pattern holds across settings; reported per intervention.

outputs: Rounded aggregates only to docs/score_sufficiency.json (no per-query values; TripClick terms). Script: scripts/69_score_sufficiency.py.

amendments.status: Added AFTER the primary results (f198bc7) were seen, at reviewer-style request: without a reference, the in-sample bin oracle's share of V* cannot be judged. Committed before computing.
amendments.reference_comparison: For each setting, every stored benefit-oriented score T (benefit_linear, B1_gbdt, probe_10 where stored; NQC as a second QPP score): the same B_star_K10 (in-sample 10-bin oracle) and B_calibrated (cross-fitted) as for S, shares of V* at every budget, kappa=0. Contrast: B_star_K10(T) minus B_star_K10(S), averaged over budgets 10-75%, paired bootstrap (10,000, seed 42), 95% CI; descriptive, no Holm. FiQA probe scores were not stored and are not recomputed.
amendments.figure_data: Per setting, 10 equal-frequency test bins of S: P(F) and P(Delta>0) with bootstrap 95% CIs (2,000 resamples per bin), for a candidate figure; settings for the figure chosen as one per corpus with the intervention that acts most (NQ reranking, TripClick reranking, ArguAna reranking, FiQA reranking), fixed now.
